<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    result = None
    for candidate in [row]:
        if candidate["owner_id"] == actor["id"] or candidate["tenant_id"] == actor["tenant_id"]:
            result = candidate
    return result
